text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both modestly lower on the day, with BTC showing slightly more weakness, though neither has broken significant support. The Fear & Greed index sitting at 69 (Greed) with no directional shift over the past week suggests the market remains confident but not euphoric—a steady, measured sentiment. Bitcoin's 59% dominance and the $72B in 24h volume indicate healthy participation across altcoins rather than a flight to safety, pointing to a market holding its ground rather than panicking or surging.
